note:
Their own published feed, not a scraped board. Since 2026-10-07 Flash Grain sets its basis only on its own site (flshgrn.com, admin page) and no longer posts bids to DTN, so the old DTN AgHost board at flashgrains.com (down since early October) is not where its prices live. The site's harvester writes feed/granton.json every 10 minutes in the emmert-cash-bids/2 schema, with cash computed by the public page's own code (dnilgis/flashgrain tools/feed.mjs), so this reads exactly what a farmer sees there.

identityAlternative: like the Badger Grain and Midwest Commodity feeds, this carries no futures price, so cash - basis = futures cannot run on it. The adapter's three checks stand in: status "ok" (the site publishes "stale" once its harvester has been silent 2 hours, the line its own page withholds cash at), `observed` inside the 14-hour line, and cash - basis inside the futures band.

When the site moves from flshgrn.com to flashgrain.com, change `url` here; the dnilgis/flashgrain README launch checklist says so.
publicNote: Their own posted cash bids at Granton, taken from the feed Flash Grain publishes on its website. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The feed carries no futures price and none is republished.
